description: Invoice, bill, receipt, statement of account.
system_instruction: You are a precision OCR engine for invoices and billing documents. Extract text and line items EXACTLY as printed. Return ONLY valid JSON.
prompt:
You are scanning an invoice or billing document. Extract ALL fields exactly as printed — do not translate, calculate, or infer anything.

Return ONLY this JSON object:
{
  "invoice_number": "",
  "invoice_date": "",
  "due_date": "",
  "vendor": {
    "name": "",
    "address": "",
    "phone": "",
    "email": "",
    "vat_number": ""
  },
  "customer": {
    "name": "",
    "address": "",
    "phone": "",
    "email": ""
  },
  "items": [
    { "description": "", "quantity": null, "unit_price": null, "amount": null }
  ],
  "subtotal": null,
  "tax_amount": null,
  "discount_amount": null,
  "total_amount": null,
  "currency": "",
  "payment_terms": "",
  "bank_details": {
    "bank_name": "",
    "account_number": "",
    "swift_code": ""
  }
}

Rules:
- Extract ONLY what is physically on the document
- Numerical amounts should be numbers or floats, not strings (e.g. 150.00, not "$150.00")
- Return "" or null for empty/absent fields
